qa_pairs.question: I opened my NovaBook 14 and want to return it. I am an active OrbitPlus member, so how many days do I have and is a restocking fee charged?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. OrbitPlus extends only the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days; it does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, so the restocking fee still applies unless the device is verified defective during the return window.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: My order status just changed to Packing and I want to cancel it. What are my options and how fast would a refund arrive?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is Confirmed. Once the status becomes Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery, and after inspection refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

contexts.text: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`. Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

qa_pairs.question: I bought a promotional bundle and want to return the main device but keep the free gift. How is my refund calculated?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund. This rule also applies when the main device is otherwise within the return window.

contexts.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund. This rule also applies when the main device is otherwise within the return window described in `05_returns_and_exchanges.md`.

A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted. An exchange is processed as a return plus a new order; price differences, current promotions, and stock availability apply to the new order.

qa_pairs.question: My box arrived crushed and one item is missing. What do I have to do, and what if I only find a defect weeks later?

The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process, and a defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process.

qa_pairs.question: My PulsePhone X stopped working after liquid exposure. Is that covered, and what happens next?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes liquid exposure, so this is an excluded issue. For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote that remains valid for seven calendar days, and work begins only after approval and required payment.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after approval and required payment.

qa_pairs.question: Someone placed an order on my account without my permission. What should I do first?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The customer should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, the customer should also attempt cancellation from the account page. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams and cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. qa_pairs.question: I placed my order on August 20, 2026, the device arrived on August 28 and I have already opened it. I am an OrbitPlus member. How many return days and what restocking fee apply?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Return Policy version 1.0 applies because the order was placed before September 1, 2026. Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership, so OrbitPlus adds nothing here. The triggering event for eligibility is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: I placed an order on September 10, 2026 and then activated OrbitPlus a week later. Do I get the 45-day unopened return window?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The membership benefit must be active when the order is placed, and activating OrbitPlus after an order does not retroactively change the price or shipping fee. qa_pairs.question: I cracked my phone screen by dropping it and then bought OrbitPlus. Can I claim it under warranty, and if I get a replacement does my 24-month warranty restart?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes accidental impact, and accidental damage is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident; OrbitPlus does not extend a product warranty. Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty, and replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty.

contexts.text: Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

qa_pairs.question: My express package has had no tracking update for three business days past the estimate. Can I get a refund now and will my express fee be returned?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date, and at that point support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period. Express-shipping fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, customs hold, severe weather, or another listed carrier exception. A failed carrier trace may move the case to a specialist.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

Express-shipping fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, customs hold, severe weather, or another listed carrier exception.

qa_pairs.question: My covered repair has been waiting on a part for four weeks and support closed the case without resolving it. What can I do?

The complaint should identify the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence, and a supervisor reviews it within five business days. Opening duplicate cases can delay assignment and does not change priority.

contexts.text: If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.
